AOC 24G11ZE 23.8 Inch FHD Fast IPS 240Hz Gaming Monitor

Unlock professional-grade competitive speed with the AOC 24G11ZE 23.8 Inch gaming monitor, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on an ultra-responsive Full HD 1920x1080 Fast IPS panel, this display delivers breathtaking visuals combined with an overclocked 240Hz refresh rate (200Hz Native) and a blistering 0.3ms MPRT response time to eliminate motion blur entirely. Engineered for esports, it features elite color performance covering 127% sRGB and 94% DCI-P3 spectrums with an outstanding color accuracy rating of Delta E less than 2. Boasting a striking black and red gaming aesthetic, 300 nits of brightness, and flexible connectivity with DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.0 ports. This high-refresh gaming display comes backed by a comprehensive 3-year warranty plan.
